tailoring.headline: Product Owner & Techno-Functional E-Commerce Consultant | SAP Commerce Cloud
tailoring.summary: Techno-functional e-commerce consultant and backend developer with 5+ years of experience delivering large-scale enterprise platforms on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris). Proven expertise in defining product vision, requirements analysis, user stories, agile delivery, and managing integrations between PIM, ERP, and MDM systems. Skilled in leading international teams, stakeholder management, and bridging business and technical domains for digital e-commerce platforms.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Product Owner Digital e-commerce (H/F)
cover_en.hook: Davidson Consulting's commitment to horizontal management, B Corp values, and impactful client solutions strongly resonates with my professional ethos. With over 5 years of experience delivering enterprise SAP Commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep techno-functional expertise in managing digital e-commerce projects and aligning business vision with technical execution.

bullets.label: Product Vision & Roadmap
bullets.text: Acted in a techno-functional role bridging business stakeholders and technical teams, defining requirements, writing user stories, and translating business goals into robust SAP Commerce solutions.

bullets.label: Agile Delivery & Scrum
bullets.text: Successfully delivered complex e-commerce features within Agile and Scrum frameworks, ensuring high quality, stakeholder alignment, and adherence to project requirements.

bullets.label: Stakeholder & Client Management
bullets.text: Collaborated directly with international business and technical stakeholders across global channels to manage digital asset development and platform integrations.

bullets.label: Platform & Integration Expertise
bullets.text: Designed and optimized large-scale web platform architectures, APIs, and PIM/ERP data pipelines on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105 and 2211) to support seamless omnichannel customer experiences.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit, and am serving a notice period with my last working day on 15 December 2026 (earliest start 16 December 2026). I look forward to discussing how my techno-functional e-commerce expertise can support Davidson Consulting's clients.

tailoring.why_company: Davidson Consulting's unique B Corp model, horizontal management, and dedication to meaningful impact deeply appeal to me. I want to bring my 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce and techno-functional consulting experience to Davidson to help major accounts successfully design and deliver their digital platforms while upholding strong collaborative values.
tailoring.motivation_short: I combine 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce delivery with strong techno-functional consulting, bridging business vision and technical execution for major international clients.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! I am an experienced e-commerce consultant and SAP Commerce developer with 5+ years at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I noticed Davidson's exciting digital projects and would love to connect to discuss how my techno-functional and Agile background fits your team. Best, Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Product Owner Digital e-commerce (H/F) - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Product Owner Digital e-commerce position at Davidson Consulting. With over 5 years of experience delivering enterprise e-commerce platforms, defining functional requirements, and managing stakeholder collaborations within Agile environments, I am eager to contribute to your digital consulting projects.

Please find my CV and cover letter attached. I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid work permit, and am available from 16 December 2026.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
